description: Requirements at vehicle, system, subsystem, component and process level.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.title: Vehicle certified range
records.statement: The vehicle shall achieve a certified combined range of not less than 490 km on the applicable light-duty test procedure at start of production.

records.title: Kerb mass target
records.statement: The vehicle kerb mass in AWD Long Range configuration shall not exceed 2100 kg.

records.title: Front axle load limit
records.statement: The permissible front axle load shall not be exceeded in any approved loading configuration.

records.title: Service brake stopping performance
records.statement: The service brake system shall meet the applicable braking performance requirements for the vehicle category under the conditions defined by the approval authority.

records.title: Pass-by noise compliance
records.statement: The vehicle shall comply with the applicable sound emission approval requirements for its category.

records.title: Vehicle electromagnetic compatibility
records.statement: The vehicle shall comply with the applicable electromagnetic compatibility approval requirements in all operating and charging modes.

records.title: Electric powertrain safety approval
records.statement: The vehicle electric power train shall comply with the applicable electric power train approval requirements.

records.title: Frontal impact occupant protection
records.statement: Occupant protection in frontal impact shall meet the applicable approval requirements.

records.title: Usable pack energy
records.statement: The HV battery shall provide not less than 78.0 kWh usable energy at beginning of life measured under the reference discharge condition.

records.title: Cell temperature operating window
records.statement: The HV battery shall maintain all cell temperatures within the qualified operating window during all defined drive and charge duty cycles.

records.title: Maximum cell temperature gradient
records.statement: The maximum steady-state temperature difference between any two monitored cells shall not exceed 6 K during normal operation.

records.title: State of health at end of warranty
records.statement: The HV battery shall retain not less than 70 percent of beginning-of-life usable energy at the end of the traction battery warranty period.

records.title: HV isolation resistance
records.statement: The HV system shall maintain isolation resistance above the qualified minimum under all specified environmental conditions.

records.title: Pack ingress protection
records.statement: The battery pack enclosure shall meet the specified ingress protection classification against dust and water.

records.title: Pack pressure equalisation
records.statement: The pack enclosure shall equalise internal pressure across the specified altitude and temperature range without loss of sealing integrity.

records.title: SOC estimation accuracy
records.statement: The BMS shall estimate pack state of charge to within 3 percent absolute error across the qualified temperature and current range.

records.title: Cell overtemperature protection
records.statement: The BMS shall limit or interrupt power when any monitored cell temperature exceeds the defined protection threshold.

records.title: Cell balancing convergence
records.statement: The BMS shall reduce cell voltage spread to below the defined convergence limit within the specified balancing duration.

records.title: HV contactor interruption capability
records.statement: The battery disconnect unit shall interrupt the HV circuit within the specified time under the defined fault current condition.

records.title: Contactor endurance cycles
records.statement: The HV main contactor shall complete the specified number of load switching cycles without welding or contact degradation beyond the qualified limit.

records.title: Cooling plate heat rejection
records.statement: The pack cooling plate shall reject the specified thermal load at the defined coolant inlet temperature and flow rate.

records.title: Cooling plate leak integrity
records.statement: The cooling plate assembly shall exhibit no detectable coolant leakage at the specified proof pressure after thermal and vibration conditioning.

records.title: Battery thermal capability at high ambient
records.statement: The thermal management system shall maintain the HV battery within its operating window during sustained high-load operation at the maximum qualified ambient temperature.

records.title: Thermal derate transparency
records.statement: Any thermally driven power limitation shall be communicated to the driver and recorded in vehicle diagnostics.

records.title: Thermal arbitration priority
records.statement: The thermal control strategy shall arbitrate cooling capacity between battery, powertrain and cabin loads according to the defined priority scheme.

records.title: Coolant flow rate at rated pump duty
records.statement: The battery coolant loop shall deliver the specified volumetric flow rate at rated pump duty and nominal system restriction.

records.title: DC fast charge time
records.statement: The vehicle shall charge the HV battery from 10 percent to 80 percent state of charge in not more than 32 minutes at the reference DC charging station and reference ambient temperature.

records.title: Charge interface interoperability
records.statement: The vehicle shall establish and complete a charging session with charging stations implementing the applicable vehicle-to-grid communication interface.

records.title: Charge inlet thermal protection
records.statement: The charge control function shall reduce charging current when the charge inlet contact temperature exceeds the defined protection threshold.

records.title: Inlet temperature sensor accuracy
records.statement: The charge inlet temperature sensor shall report contact temperature within the specified accuracy across the qualified temperature range.

records.title: Charge derate ramp behaviour
records.statement: Charging current reduction shall follow the defined ramp profile to avoid station-side session termination.

records.title: AC charging power
records.statement: The on-board charger shall deliver 11 kW AC charging power at nominal three-phase supply.

records.title: Peak drive power
records.statement: The electric drive unit shall deliver the specified peak power for not less than the defined duration from a thermally conditioned start state.

records.title: Continuous drive power
records.statement: The electric drive unit shall sustain the specified continuous power without exceeding component thermal limits.

records.title: Unintended torque prevention
records.statement: The drive system shall not produce unintended propulsion torque exceeding the defined safe limit.

records.title: Inverter thermal derate onset
records.statement: The inverter shall initiate power derating at the defined junction temperature threshold before reaching the protection limit.

records.title: Motor insulation integrity
records.statement: The traction motor winding insulation shall withstand the specified dielectric test after environmental and durability conditioning.

records.title: Cold performance stopping distance
records.statement: The service brake system shall achieve the required cold performance stopping distance for the vehicle category.

records.title: Fade and recovery performance
records.statement: The service brake system shall meet the applicable fade and recovery performance requirements.

records.title: Regenerative braking blending
records.statement: Blending between regenerative and friction braking shall be imperceptible to the driver in pedal feel and deceleration response.

records.title: Brake judder limit
records.statement: Brake-induced steering wheel and seat track vibration shall not exceed the defined subjective and objective judder limits over the service life.

records.title: Friction material substance restriction
records.statement: Front brake friction material shall comply with applicable restrictions on copper and other restricted substances in the target markets.

records.title: Friction coefficient stability
records.statement: The friction coefficient shall remain within the specified band across the qualified temperature, pressure and speed envelope.

records.title: Disc thickness variation limit
records.statement: Front brake disc thickness variation shall remain below the specified limit throughout the durability test schedule.

records.title: Brake noise occurrence rate
records.statement: Audible brake noise occurrence shall remain below the defined rate during the noise evaluation schedule.

records.title: Suspension structural durability
records.statement: Suspension components shall complete the vehicle durability schedule without crack initiation or loss of function.

records.title: Control arm bushing radial rate
records.statement: The front lower control arm rear bushing radial stiffness shall remain within the specified tolerance band at the reference temperature and preload.

records.title: Ride comfort target
records.statement: Vertical ride acceleration on the reference road surfaces shall not exceed the defined comfort target.

records.title: Road noise transfer limit
records.statement: Structure-borne road noise transferred to the cabin shall not exceed the defined level in the specified frequency bands.

records.title: Rear subframe isolation
records.statement: The rear subframe isolation shall attenuate powertrain and road excitation by the specified amount in the target frequency range.

records.title: Handling stability at maximum mass
records.statement: Vehicle handling stability targets shall be met at maximum permissible mass and load distribution.

records.title: Steering approval compliance
records.statement: The steering equipment shall comply with the applicable steering approval requirements.

records.title: Steering assist loss safe state
records.statement: Loss of steering assist shall result in a defined safe state with manual steerability retained.

records.title: Steering ECU processing integrity
records.statement: The steering ECU processing element shall provide the diagnostic coverage required by the allocated safety integrity level.

records.title: Steering assist response time
records.statement: The steering assist torque shall respond within the specified time constant to driver torque input.

records.title: Radiated emissions limit
records.statement: Vehicle radiated emissions shall remain within the applicable approval limits in drive and charge modes.

records.title: Radiated immunity
records.statement: Vehicle functions shall remain within defined performance criteria when exposed to the applicable radiated field strengths.

records.title: HV harness shield continuity
records.statement: HV harness shielding shall provide continuous low impedance bonding between shield terminations along the full routing path.

records.title: HV harness routing separation
records.statement: HV harness routing shall maintain the specified minimum separation from sensitive low voltage and antenna circuits.

records.title: Bus load limit
records.statement: Communication bus utilisation shall not exceed the defined maximum under worst-case message loading.

records.title: Diagnostic service support
records.statement: The vehicle shall support the required unified diagnostic services for all emissions and safety relevant functions.

records.title: Cybersecurity risk treatment
records.statement: Cybersecurity risks identified for vehicle communication interfaces shall be treated in accordance with the applicable cybersecurity engineering process.

records.title: LV transient immunity
records.statement: Low voltage electronics shall withstand the specified conducted transients on supply lines without loss of function.

records.title: Cabin cool-down time
records.statement: The HVAC system shall reduce cabin temperature from the specified soak condition to the target temperature within the defined time.

records.title: HVAC energy consumption limit
records.statement: HVAC energy consumption shall not exceed the defined allocation within the vehicle energy budget under the reference climate cycle.

records.title: Compressor operating envelope
records.statement: The electric compressor shall operate across the specified pressure and speed envelope without protective shutdown.

records.title: Compressor NVH limit
records.statement: Compressor-induced cabin noise shall not exceed the defined level at any operating point.

records.title: Calibration configuration control
records.statement: Every released calibration dataset shall be uniquely identified and traceable to the software version and vehicle configuration it is approved for.

records.title: Calibration readback
records.statement: The active calibration identifier shall be readable through the vehicle diagnostic interface.

records.title: Update rollback capability
records.statement: A failed software update shall roll back to the previously approved software and calibration state.

records.title: Energy consumption calibration accuracy
records.statement: The displayed range estimate shall track measured energy consumption within the defined error band over the reference cycle.

records.title: Tyre rolling resistance allocation
records.statement: Fitted tyres shall meet the rolling resistance allocation defined in the vehicle energy budget.

records.title: Tyre load and speed capability
records.statement: Fitted tyres shall meet or exceed the load and speed capability required at maximum permissible axle load.

records.title: Tyre rolling sound emission
records.statement: Fitted tyres shall comply with the applicable rolling sound emission approval requirements.

records.title: Wheel unsprung mass allocation
records.statement: Wheel and tyre assembly mass shall remain within the unsprung mass allocation defined for the chassis tuning.

records.title: TPMS detection threshold
records.statement: The tyre pressure monitoring function shall detect and indicate pressure loss at the defined threshold.

records.title: Cooling plate braze joint integrity
records.statement: Braze joints on the cooling plate shall achieve the specified minimum joint coverage with no through-wall porosity.

records.title: Leak test capability
records.statement: The end-of-line leak test shall demonstrate measurement system capability adequate for the specified leak rate limit.

records.title: Bushing press-fit process capability
records.statement: The bushing press-fit operation shall demonstrate the required process capability index on press force and final position.

records.title: Busbar weld strength
records.statement: Module busbar welds shall meet the specified minimum tensile strength and electrical resistance limits.

records.title: Tailpipe emissions compliance
records.statement: The vehicle shall comply with the applicable pollutant emission approval requirements over the required test procedures.

records.title: Catalyst light-off behaviour
records.statement: The aftertreatment system shall reach effective conversion within the defined time from cold start under the reference test conditions.

records.title: In-service conformity durability
records.statement: Emissions performance shall remain compliant over the required durability distance.

records.title: OBD malfunction detection
records.statement: The on-board diagnostic system shall detect and indicate emissions-relevant malfunctions as required.

records.title: Restraint deployment timing
records.statement: Restraint deployment shall occur within the defined timing window for the applicable crash pulse severities.

records.title: Inadvertent deployment prevention
records.statement: The restraint system shall not deploy inadvertently under any non-crash operating condition.

records.title: LV supply availability
records.statement: The low voltage supply shall remain within the specified voltage band for all safety relevant loads under worst-case demand.

records.title: DC-DC converter rated output
records.statement: The DC-DC converter shall deliver rated output power across the qualified HV input and thermal range.

records.title: Perception availability in adverse conditions
records.statement: Driving assistance functions shall degrade in a defined and communicated manner when sensing performance falls below the qualified threshold.

records.title: Radar detection range
records.statement: The forward radar shall meet the specified detection range and angular accuracy across the qualified environmental envelope.
